title: Nvidia Posts $115.8B Quarter as Vera Rubin Ships
dek: First earnings since Jensen Huang stepped down, led by interim CEO Colette Kress

facts.label: Revenue growth vs. a year ago
Q4 revenue outlook, plus or minus 3%

caption:
Nvidia just doubled its revenue in a year, and it did it without Jensen Huang at the top. 📈

Nvidia reported $115.8 billion for Q3 of fiscal 2027, up 103% year over year and well above the roughly $109.3 billion analysts expected. Data Center sales hit $107.6 billion, net income reached a record $65.3 billion, and Vera Rubin NVL72 racks began shipping in what Nvidia calls its fastest product ramp ever, already running at CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and Oracle.

The quarter also bundled major AI deals: expanded Vera Rubin access for Anthropic, a wider Meta deployment, and an agreement to acquire Hugging Face. Interim CEO Colette Kress says "our momentum is real" and guides Q4 to $130 billion.

At AI Parabellum we think the takeaway is simple: demand for AI compute isn't slowing, which matters for anyone using Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini. The real open question is who leads Nvidia next.

The chipmaker posted $115.8 billion in revenue and $65.3 billion in net income as Vera Rubin shipments ramped, then guided Q4 to $130 billion. Demand is clearly there; now the board has to pick a CEO. 🔥
